_comment: Machine-readable index of the TRRs in this folder. Each entry's fields mirror tired-labs/techniques index.json (name, id, tactics, contributors, external_ids, platforms, procedures, pub_date, last_update, tests). NOTE: upstream index.json is a BARE top-level ARRAY of these entry objects; this file wraps them in {_comment, trrs:[]} and adds a local 'path' field for convenience. When contributing upstream, emit the entry into the top-level array and drop the wrapper and 'path'. 'id' values are LOCAL and live in the TRR9000+ band to avoid colliding with upstream's sequentially assigned IDs (upstream's TRR0001 is a reserved example and real reports climb from the low numbers). At contribution time copy to trr0000/ and let the maintainer assign the final upstream ID.

D.text: det-eng eBPF program-load behavioral atomic (bpf half)
